recommendations.title: Increase Training Frequency
recommendations.recommendationText: Aim to train each major muscle group 2-3 times per week.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Training muscles infrequently limits the muscle protein synthesis response.
expectedBenefits: Maximized muscle protein synthesis and faster growth.

recommendations.title: Implement Progressive Overload
recommendations.recommendationText: Keep a workout log and aim to increase weight or reps every session.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Without progressive overload, muscles adapt and stop growing.
actionSteps: Aim to add 1 rep or 1 kg each week

recommendations.title: Hit Your Protein Target
recommendations.recommendationText: Consume 1.6-2.2g of protein per kg of body weight daily.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Protein provides the essential building blocks for muscle.

recommendations.title: Post-Workout Nutrition
recommendations.recommendationText: Consume 20-40g of high-quality protein within 2 hours of your workout.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: The post-workout window is optimal for kickstarting recovery.
actionSteps: Prepare a post-workout shake or meal
expectedBenefits: Faster recovery and reduced muscle soreness.

recommendations.title: Establish a Caloric Surplus
recommendations.recommendationText: Add 250-500 extra calories to your daily intake.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Building muscle is an energy-intensive process.
actionSteps: Track your calories for a week to find maintenance
Add 300 calories via a shake or extra meal
expectedBenefits: Provides the energy required for hypertrophy.

recommendations.title: Prioritize Sleep & Recovery
recommendations.recommendationText: Aim for 7-9 hours of sleep and 1-2 complete rest days per week.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Muscle growth happens during rest, not during workouts.
expectedBenefits: Improved recovery and reduced risk of overtraining.

recommendations.title: Build a Consistent Routine
recommendations.recommendationText: Schedule your workouts in your calendar like important appointments.
recommendations.whyThisMatters: Consistency is the most important factor in long-term muscle building.
actionSteps: Block out workout times in your calendar
Prepare gym bag the night before
